final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ds.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, AVG(ds.wins) AS a FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ds.raceId, c.country), s2 AS (SELECT country, AVG(a) AS a FROM s1 GROUP BY country), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS a FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.country AS country, s2.a AS a, s2.a - s3.a AS d FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s2.a > s3.a), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS a FROM s4) SELECT s4.country, s4.a, s4.d, s4.a - s5.a AS e FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s4.a > s5.a
